feedback_log: v1: sunset bg, supplied transparent man+card cut-out unchanged, headline bottom-left 3 lines white+honey with dark scrim, honey pill tagline, brown full band footer with honey pieces, NIB white pill left, NIBtera Online white pill right

v2 (Bamlak): background didn't fit the man's high camera angle/legs -> generated a new golden-sunset plate in ChatGPT shot from a high angle (ground plane seen from above, sun glare upper-left), re-placed contact + cast shadows under his shoes; everything else unchanged

v3 (creative director, Miro sticky on v2): 'The shadow of the feet needs fixing!!!' -> replaced blob ellipses with a shadow cast from the man's own leg/shoe silhouette, starting at the sole contact lines (left toe->heel, right heel->toe), sheared away from the sun (upper-left), foreshortened, sharp at contact and softer/fading with distance, plus a thin contact occlusion; script work/shadow_wed.py

v4 (Bamlak): taglines moved to the top-left: headline 61px below the NIB logo, tagline pill exactly double that gap (122px) below the headline; headline 84px, pill text 32px so it clears the hand; scrim moved behind the headline for contrast. Everything else unchanged

standing_rules: NIBtera Online pill ALWAYS top-right (right:75 top:28). Never move it; keep photo subjects (hands, heads) out of that corner instead.
NIB International Bank logo gets its own white oval background (left:62 top:28) whenever it is not clearly legible on the photo (branding priority). Used on Tap v4.
Scanning/action scenes must clearly show the action (e.g. scanner phone camera aimed at the QR).
When both phones must show screens, use a high-angle photo (green chroma screen on the scanner phone, white on the QR phone) and composite real UI on both.

Phone owners are different people: give them visibly different hands (use Project files 'Pretty woman hand(s).png' as reference for the woman's hand). For scan scenes use the scanner's first-person POV, scanner phone in foreground aimed at the other phone.
NIBtera Online logo (white pill) on every post, top-right (Bamlak, Nov 20).

Headline font: Nokia Bold (source/NokiaBold.ttf, from Project Amharic font pack) at ~92-96px with 4px same-colour text-stroke for extra boldness, yellow #fdb913; sub-tagline ribbons are fully rounded pills (border-radius 999px), never squared (Bamlak, Nov 20).

Telegram sends: ALWAYS use a commit-pinned URL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bamlak27/nib-posts/<full commit sha>/posts/<file>.png (never /main/?v=N - GitHub CDN serves stale cached copies). After sending, check Telegram file_size equals the local file size; if not, resend.

Footer: content always the same (Follow us+socials+web, QR scan me, 24/7 9698, sign-off) but STYLE must be varied between graphics. Styles so far: (1) full-width brown band; (2) floating pill band with yellow Follow-us section and white text on brown (source/nib-building.html .fb). Product logo top-right changes per service (NIBtera Building for building posts). Logo may also be placed inline in the tagline.
White/plain-background photos: cut out the subject and use source/honey_bg.svg (approved-post honeycomb: large pale cream/yellow hexes + yellow circle behind subject).
Taglines mix brand yellow #fdb913 and brown (not one colour) and need not sit at the top - place them in free space, lower down when there is room.
Reviewer feedback may be a reply to an older file: use reply_to_message in getUpdates (its caption/file_name) to identify which post/version it targets before editing.
Never change the NIB colour theme: yellow #fdb913, brown #8a4d1f, cream; no orange backgrounds (Bamlak, Nov 26)
Whenever a phone appears, add App Store + Google Play badges with the line ንብ ተራ ኦንላይንን አውርደው ይጠቀሙ! (Bamlak, Nov 26)
Use the updated NIB ATM (yellow body, brown top/side panel with white zigzag, black base, bee icon) from the director's reference image in all ATM scenes (Bamlak, Nov 26)

Sign-off must look like the supplied yellow/honey bee-line artwork (use c_sig on brown); download tagline is ንብተራ ኦንላይንን አውርደው ይጠቀሙ! written plain, no card needed; the NIB ATM must be slim/tall like the reference (Bamlak, Nov 26)

ALWAYS generate the image scene with ChatGPT (never hand-cut models); correct it with detailed prompts + face close-up references until faces match; follow the inspo placement/pose exactly; people waist-up with realistic scale to the building; empty background = honeycomb (Bamlak, Nov 26)
